market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$103, needs to dip to $90 (~13% drop). Pre-Iran-tension fundamentals were lower-$90s but current geopolitical premium is sticky. A drop to $90 would require both ceasefire holding and Strait reopening with weak demand confirmation. Possible but lower probability than $95.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Speed of Iran de-escalation and supply normalization
